purpose_context: Kent's new multi-client commitments (Intentional consulting, spec-kitty fractional-exec, business acquisition) create real time-tracking admin. This mission lets Kent log time conversationally over WhatsApp and have Felix write it — correctly and observably — to a fresh Felix-owned Google Sheets workbook (one tab per client), the first EA capability built on the just-shipped trust core (#683 no-fabrication + #701 alerting).
purpose_tldr: Log billable time by texting WhatsApp; Felix appends it to the right client tab of a Google Sheet.
